approvals.reason: Live session rows named the item content_id where playback history says media_item_id for the same value; the row takes history's name before the lock. No first-party client decodes household session rows (silo-apple, silo-android and silo-roku main checked); the web app is updated in the same change.

Live session rows carried the episode's title in episode_name; it moves to media_title, as playback history has it, before the lock. No first-party client decodes household session rows (silo-apple, silo-android and silo-roku main checked); the web app is updated in the same change.

Live session rows carried the show in series_name; it becomes series_title, as playback history and the rest of v2 have it, before the lock. No first-party client decodes household session rows (silo-apple, silo-android and silo-roku main checked); the web app is updated in the same change.
